title: Mind · Body · Spirit/Time — Father, Son and Ladder
thesis: Father/Mind and Son/Body are differentiated functions inside one Potato of Life; Spirit is living continuity through ordered positions and time. Ladder is the ordered relation; Spiral is Ladder unfolded through recurrence/history; Door/Here is the current transition state.

formal_schematic.spiral_condition: a projected motif may recur while the full state differs: pi(Gamma(t1)) = pi(Gamma(t2)) but Gamma(t1) != Gamma(t2)

akashic_relation: Akashic Tree is a provenance/memory metaphor: Roots=sources, Trunk=current synthesis, Branches=knowledge, Leaves=views, Fruit=outputs, Seeds=future transferable patterns.
fibonacci_relation: Golden/Fibonacci scaling may parameterize selected spiral/growth visualizations; it is not universal spiritual law or proof.
eleven_d_relation: 11D project/science work can serve as a typed higher-description comparator, but physical M-theory does not establish the project spiritual mappings.
no_escape_rule: A complete ascent returns into Body/World as action, service, art, repair, teaching or new Seed.
